scope: Descriptive pairwise and leave-one-out visual-component ISC in one fixed released movie-viewing convenience cohort. This is a method-control adaptation, not paper replication or population, causal, age-development or chance-significance inference.

source.dataset: Nilearn development_fmri derivative of OpenNeuro ds000228
source.frame_indices: all original integer frame indices 0 through 167 in original order
source.clock_interpretation: Loader-index convention only; no measured movie-onset alignment or exporter slice-time reference is asserted. No additional dummy removal, shortest-prefix truncation, censoring, lag search or temporal interpolation.
source.atlas: MSDL, all 39 released overlapping maps jointly fitted
source.map_ids: zero-based original atlas fourth-axis indices 0 through 38
source_preconditions: Authenticate the closed manifest inventory before scientific decoding.
Each fixed person has exactly one BOLD and full confounds file and exactly 168 corresponding rows/frames.
Scaled BOLD, map values and all 15 selected confounds must be finite; unexpected missing values fail rather than trigger unrecorded imputation.
Atlas has 39 map volumes and 39 label rows; each selected visual label appears exactly once.
Source affines are finite invertible spatial transforms; preserve source units, scaling and raw timing metadata.

spatial_extraction.dtype: float64 throughout scaling, resampling, least squares and temporal processing
spatial_extraction.target: each participant's original BOLD spatial grid; no BOLD spatial resampling
spatial_extraction.coordinate_mapping: atlas voxel coordinate = scipy.linalg.inv(atlas affine) @ BOLD affine @ homogeneous BOLD voxel center. If source and target affines are exactly equal and spatial shapes match, copy the atlas grid without interpolation. This explicit reference arithmetic avoids a hidden inverse-versus-solve boundary convention.
spatial_extraction.interpolation: trilinear order 1; scipy.ndimage.affine_transform with mode=constant, cval=0, prefilter=False; dispatch the three diagonal entries as a vector when the spatial transform is exactly diagonal, otherwise use its full3x3 matrix. Apply to all original39 maps. Oracle and grader share this SciPy transform/interpolator; separate composition and least-squares routes do not establish independent interpolation algorithms.
spatial_extraction.clip: clip interpolated values to [min(0, original atlas global minimum), max(0, original atlas global maximum)]; negative map weights are not rectified
spatial_extraction.spatial_scope: Operational affine-coordinate measurement, not verified nonlinear inter-template registration
spatial_extraction.mask: none; include the full BOLD voxel grid, including rows where all map values are zero
spatial_extraction.voxel_order: ascending C-flat spatial index, consistently for design-map rows and scaled BOLD voxel rows
spatial_extraction.model: For each person solve M @ B = Y with M[V,39], Y[V,168], all maps together; raw_coefficients = B.T

solver.rank_deficiency: retain all39 coefficient columns and report rank; singular values are optional diagnostics. Do not drop maps or people.

filter.application: scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt along original time axis separately per person, to coefficients and all 15 confounds
filter.padlen_origin: explicit SciPy default for the specified five-section bandpass SOS

temporal_cleaning.nuisance: After filtering, center each confound and divide by population SD; if SD < eps64 use divisor 1. scipy.linalg.qr(confounds, mode='economic', pivoting=True); retain Q columns where abs(diag(R)) > 100*eps64; residual = filtered coefficients - Q@(Q.T@filtered coefficients).
temporal_cleaning.final_standardization: Center each residual map timecourse; divide by sample SD (ddof=1), using divisor 1 when SD < eps64. Then select the three named visual components without mixing their timecourses.
temporal_cleaning.amendment: The old hidden second population-SD plus 1e-9 normalization is removed. Explicit float64 extraction/cleaning replaces implicit dtype behavior. This prospectively specified recipe is not claimed bitwise equivalent to the old oracle.
temporal_cleaning.software_semantics: Nilearn 0.13.1 masker defaults made explicit; oracle and grader may implement these equations separately. Shared SciPy/NumPy operators are disclosed, not claimed fully independent algorithms.

support_and_fidelity.center: ISC-only centering uses accurately summed original-frame arithmetic mean (reference math.fsum/N); if all values equal the first value, return exact zeros. Cleaning above retains its specified NumPy means/std.
support_and_fidelity.centered_L2: Stable scaled Euclidean norm: s=max(abs(centered)); zero if s=0, otherwise s*sqrt(accurately summed (centered/s)^2).
support_and_fidelity.canonical_active_rule: centered_L2 > 1e-12 * sqrt(168), separately for each final participant-region series and each literal leave-one-out mean template
support_and_fidelity.canonical_support: Source reconstruction defines participant and template activity. Submitted support flags must match; no threshold recalculation from rounded submitted values replaces canonical support.
support_and_fidelity.inactive: Canonical inactive vectors/templates remain undefined for correlations even if accepted serialization introduces small variation. Their finite series values remain source-bound.
support_and_fidelity.active_fidelity: For every canonical-active participant series AND every canonical-active leave-one-out template, ||center(submitted)-center(canonical)||2 <= 1e-6*||center(canonical)||2, with no absolute floor. Templates are rebuilt from the submitted 39 contributors, never supplied independently.
support_and_fidelity.limitations: These are public numerical support and fidelity policies, not a hidden endpoint band. Near-cancelling active templates remain ill-conditioned; accepted precision does not guarantee robust biological endpoints. Raw coefficient receipts are evidence only and are not re-cleaned to define acceptance.

isc.correlation: center both vectors; dot product divided by the product of their centered L2 norms; only canonical-active eligible vectors are correlated
isc.roundoff_domain: clip a computed r outside [-1,1] only if its excess is <=1e-12; otherwise fail numerical precondition
isc.pairwise: C_ijr=corr(x_ir,x_jr) for each i<j. P_ir=sum(j!=i,C_ijr)/39. P_region_r=sum(i<j,C_ijr)/780.
isc.loo: m_ir=sum(j!=i,x_jr)/39 using literal ID exclusion and all39 finite contributors, including constant contributors. L_ir=corr(x_ir,m_ir), requiring the target and corresponding canonical template active; contributors need not individually be active.
isc.person: arithmetic mean over exactly the 3 named regions, separately for pairwise and LOO
isc.headline: arithmetic mean over exactly the 40 participant values; equivalently mean of 3 complete region values
isc.aggregation: arithmetic Pearson-r means only; no Fisher transform, absolute value, sign flip, diagonal inclusion, timecourse averaging across regions or outcome-based omission
isc.reduction_precision: ISC frame means, each per-frame39-person template mean, dot products and scalar aggregates use accurately summed reference arithmetic (math.fsum) in canonical frame/person/map order. Equivalent implementations meeting the public tolerances are allowed; no mandatory library fingerprint.
isc.undefined: Keep all records; no available-case denominator. Pair undefined if either person inactive. Pairwise person-region undefined unless all39 pairs defined; LOO undefined if target inactive or template inactive, not merely because a finite contributor is constant. Person undefined unless all3 regions defined; region/headline undefined unless its full expected family is defined.
isc.null_rule: Undefined CSV numbers use empty fields; undefined JSON numbers use null with explicit status and n_expected/n_defined. NPZ series are always finite and support arrays Boolean.
isc.reference_zero: 0.0 is a descriptive reference, not a computed chance distribution or significance test

verification.numeric_domain_allowance: Reported correlations and arithmetic-r means may exceed [-1,1] only by the same 1e-6 serialization tolerance; canonical replay remains in [-1,1].
verification.own_primitive_replay: After source fidelity passes, recompute all ISC and aggregation from accepted submitted final series on canonical support. Do not additionally compare derived ISC with hidden historical or source-canonical ISC values.
verification.ordering: CSV rows and NPZ participant/frame/map/visual axes may reorder coherently with their unique explicit keys. No duplicate keys. Strings are literal, not numeric-stripped participant aliases.
verification.integral_axes: NPZ ID/frame axes may use integer or real floating numeric storage if every required small integer key is represented exactly; Boolean, fractional and nonfinite axes are forbidden. Required array shapes and key memberships remain exact.
verification.extras: Harmless finite extra fields/columns/arrays within size bounds are allowed; required scientific fields cannot be replaced by fuzzy aliases. No pickle/object arrays or duplicate JSON keys.
verification.independent_route_limit: Canonical oracle least squares uses gelsd; the separate grader may reconstruct minimum-norm coefficients by gesvd and explicit pseudoinverse. These share libraries and are mathematically equivalent, not universally bit-equivalent on ill-conditioned designs. Predeclared source fidelity, source-free conditioning fixtures and a separately gated original pilot govern engineering agreement; no outcome-derived tolerance adjustment is implied.
verification.failure: failed_precondition is not a successful completed analysis. A reserved failure_report.json marker, including dangling/empty marker, invalidates an otherwise successful output directory. Never overwrite evidence.
verification.pilot: resource_pilot is explicitly partial, not production success; fixed subset computation may authenticate all sources but cannot claim full40 ISC.
